installIos: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share (the square with an up arrow; on iOS 26 it is in the ··· menu), choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap “Add”.
alignHint: Drag each circle onto a corner of the document. The thick line marks the top edge. With a keyboard: arrow keys move the selected corner and N selects the next one.
cornersInvalid: The corners cross over. Move them so they form a four-sided shape around the document.
pasteHint: You can also paste the image with Ctrl+V.
localOnly: The image is read on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
errNotImage: The file is not an image. Use a JPEG, PNG or HEIC photo.
errHeic: This browser cannot open HEIC photos. Take a screenshot of the photo or convert it to JPEG on your device.
errTooLarge: The image is too large (maximum 40 MB).
errDecode: The image could not be opened. Try another photo.
canWarning: The CAN lets anyone who holds your card read its chip. We recommend hiding it.
mrzWarning: The lines at the bottom of the back repeat your support number and dates. Hide them too, or that data stays readable.
positionsHint: The black boxes are placed from the layout of: {doc}. Check that each one covers its field.
adjustHint: Tap a box to select it. Drag it to move it, or drag its corners to resize it. While you adjust, you see the photo uncovered; the copy stays covered. With a keyboard: N selects the next box, the arrow keys move it and Shift+arrow keys resize it.
fitHint: Reads the card on this device and makes the boxes of the fields you hide bigger where the text runs past them. A box never gets smaller.
fitDone: {n} boxes made bigger to cover the text. Check them with Adjust boxes.
fitNone: The boxes already cover the text that was found.
fitUnavailable: Text reading is not available now. Adjust the boxes by hand.
fitFailed: Fitting did not work this time. Adjust the boxes by hand.
zonePosition: {field}: {x} from the left, {y} from the top, {w} × {h}
watermarkHint: For example: COPY ONLY FOR A RENTAL APPLICATION. A watermark discourages reuse but cannot prevent fraud.
reviewWarning: The black boxes may miss sensitive information. Review both sides of your document before downloading.
downloaded: PDF created. Check your downloads folder.
errExport: The PDF could not be created. Try again.
boxHint: Use extra black boxes for anything the list does not cover. Draw: turn on Draw black box and drag on the image. Select a box to move it, or drag its corners to resize it. With a keyboard: Add box, then the arrow keys move it, Shift+arrow keys resize it, N selects the next box and Delete removes it.
kicker: your ID, without giving data away
homeTitle: Share a clean copy of your ID card
homeLead: Cover what is not needed, mark what the copy is for and download a PDF ready to send.
startHint: About 2 minutes. Have your document at hand.
privacyBody: No cookies, no profiles, no data to sell. We only count visits, anonymously and without cookies. Every Eurocrat's dream: this banner only exists to tell you it isn't needed. Your photos never leave your device.
auditLead: Copy this text and paste it into your AI coding agent. It will review the source code and tell you whether your photos ever leave your device.
auditCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
docLead: Each document has its data in a different place. Choose the one you will photograph.
docHint_dni-4.0: From August 2021. EU flag on the front.
docHint_tie: Residence card with your NIE, 2020 model.
detectReading: Reading the code on the back to recognise the document…
detectDownloading: Downloading the text reader ({mb} MB, first time only) and reading the code on the back…
detectOffline: Automatic detection cannot be downloaded without a connection. Choose the document.
detectUnsupported: Automatic detection is not available in this browser. Choose the document.
detectFound: Document detected: {doc}. Check it before you continue.
detectDniVersion: This is a DNI, but it is not possible to tell if it is 3.0 or 4.0. Choose the version.
detectNone: The document could not be recognised. Choose it.
captureHint: The whole card, on a plain background, with no glare.
frameHint: Fit the document inside the frame
alignLead: Drag each point to a corner. The magnifier helps you get it right.
cornersSearching: Looking for the document in the photo…
cornersFound: We placed the corners on the document. Check them and adjust them if needed.
cornersMissed: We could not find the document in this photo. Place the corners by hand.
straightenLead: We find the document in each photo, turn it the right way up and straighten it. You can adjust the corners afterwards if needed.
legendVisible: Visible in the copy. Tap an area on the card to cover or uncover it.
legendAdjust: Adjusting: tap a box, then drag it or its corners.
greyscaleHint: Harder to pass off as the original.
reviewLead: This is exactly what goes into the PDF.
doneHint: Once you have sent it, press Clear everything. Closing the tab clears it too.
errShare: Could not share. The PDF is still in your downloads folder.
sendLeadShare: DNI Tapado.es sends nothing. Your device's share menu opens: you choose the app and the person.
sendLeadManual: DNI Tapado.es sends nothing. These links open WhatsApp or your email with a message; attach the PDF yourself from your downloads folder.
shareMessage: Here is my document with the personal data protected (protected-document.pdf).
liveFlip: Done. Now turn the card over.
liveDenied: No permission to use the camera. Use “Take a photo” or “Gallery”.
liveUnavailable: The live camera is not available. Use “Take a photo” or “Gallery”.
tipFrame: Fit the card inside the frame
tipBlur: Blurry: wait for it to focus
findIntro: Reads the card on this device and adds black boxes over the data you choose. Nothing is sent.
findDownload: The first time, this downloads about {mb} MB, once.
findDone: {n} boxes added. Check them in Boxes: you can move or delete them.
findNone: Nothing found. Hide the data by hand.
findOffline: Automatic finding needs a one-time download, and you are offline. Hide the data by hand.
findUnsupported: Automatic finding is not available in this browser. Hide the data by hand.
findFailed: Automatic finding did not work this time. Hide the data by hand.
framed: For your security, this tool only works in its own tab. Open it here.
